script:
set -e
base64 -d /tmp/u0.b64 > /tmp/mg.js
base64 -d /tmp/u1.b64 > /tmp/mg3d.js
base64 -d /tmp/u2.b64 > /tmp/mgv.js
base64 -d /tmp/u3.b64 > /tmp/mgc.css
base64 -d /tmp/u4.b64 > /tmp/mh.html
sudo cp /tmp/mg.js /var/www/xinmo-site/assets/js/memory-graph.js
sudo cp /tmp/mg3d.js /var/www/xinmo-site/assets/js/memory-graph-3d.js
sudo cp /tmp/mgv.js /var/www/xinmo-site/assets/js/memory-graph-view.js
sudo cp /tmp/mgc.css /var/www/xinmo-site/assets/css/memory-graph.css
sudo cp /tmp/mh.html /var/www/xinmo-site/memory.html
sudo chmod 644 /var/www/xinmo-site/assets/js/memory-graph.js /var/www/xinmo-site/assets/js/memory-graph-3d.js /var/www/xinmo-site/assets/js/memory-graph-view.js /var/www/xinmo-site/assets/css/memory-graph.css /var/www/xinmo-site/memory.html
sha256sum /var/www/xinmo-site/assets/js/memory-graph.js /var/www/xinmo-site/assets/js/memory-graph-3d.js /var/www/xinmo-site/assets/js/memory-graph-view.js /var/www/xinmo-site/assets/css/memory-graph.css /var/www/xinmo-site/memory.html
curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'http=%{http_code} len=%{size_download}\n' https://xinmo.work/assets/js/memory-graph-3d.js
rm -f /tmp/u0.b64 /tmp/u1.b64 /tmp/u2.b64 /tmp/u3.b64 /tmp/u4.b64
